summary: Removed the external font @import from app.css and moved the unchanged Google Fonts stylesheet URL into the document head after preconnecting to both font origins. The application stylesheet remains in the head after those font hints.
choices: Kept DM Sans, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono with their existing weights and display=swap behavior.
Used the request's Google Fonts head-link fallback rather than self-hosting, which could not be verified end to end under the no-build/no-browser constraint.
openQuestions: The docs package exposes only a project-wide `bun run typecheck`; no formatter, linter, or file-scoped typecheck command was available, so hygiene was not run.
